{{Quote|The holocron revealed much about the creation of warbeasts, but Ziost's breeding pens provided a more immediate education.|An extract from the Chronicle of Sorzus Syn, 6899 BBY|<ref name="BoS" />}}
'''Ziost's breeding pens''', located on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], were the places where [[Kissai]] [[Ninûshwodzakut]] created and hybridized [[Sithspawn/Legends|warbeasts]] for the [[Sith]]. Following the acquisition of the [[Holocron of King Nakgru]] in [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Exile Second Year">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' (p. 27) states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]].</ref> ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] visited the breeding pens and studied the creation of warbeasts, including such creatures as [[Silooth/Legends|silooth]], [[Sith warbird|warbirds]], [[Sith war behemoth|war behemoths]], [[hssiss]], [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydras]], [[chrysalide]]s, [[Sith wyrm|war wyrms]] and guardian beasts called [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]]. In her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]], Syn remarked what a "delight" it was to land among the fellow alchemists.<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ziost's breeding pens were first mentioned in the resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BoS" />
